notice: SCHEMA/EXAMPLE FIXTURE ONLY. Not production taxonomy; not validated features.

features.name: Guest present (example)
features.definition: A person explicitly introduced as a guest participates. 0=absent with sufficient evidence; 1=present; U=insufficient material.
inclusion_examples: Transcript: Today our guest is Mina; Mina then speaks.
exclusion_examples: Host only mentions a celebrity who does not participate.
required_evidence: Content quote identifying the guest and their participation; title alone may be insufficient.

features.name: First-person past experience (example)
features.definition: A speaker recounts their own past experience. 0=absent with sufficient evidence; 1=present; U=insufficient material.
inclusion_examples: I worked in a bakery when I was a student.
exclusion_examples: A hypothetical story or another person's experience.
required_evidence: Quote from available transcript with first-person subject and past event.
